description.p: Globulation 2 is a real-time strategy game where food, workers and space shape your expansion. Grow a sprawling colony, balance its competing needs, and contend with rivals for land and resources. Your creatures act autonomously, letting you guide the colony as a whole.

Grow an economy that can sustain your ambitions. Food, construction and training compete for your workforce. Decide where workers are needed and balance new ambitions with the needs of the colony you already have.
Make the map part of your strategy. Different maps call for different strategies. Adapt your expansion to the terrain, choose what to defend, and find the routes and resources your colony needs.

Defend what you've built. Your economy supports both growth and defense. Balance the needs of your colony while rivals compete for land and resources, and prepare for conflicts that can decide the match.
Globulation 2 is free and open source.

description.p: Improved mobile building inspection, HUD layout and audio setup; refreshed translations and tutorials; refined map resources and starting settlements; enabled smooth unit motion by default; and fixed browser startup with saved software rendering settings.
Updated iOS privacy packaging, fixed Mac build compatibility, and stabilized iPhone build tooling.
Improved Maxima AI planning responsiveness, admitted four building gradients per team per tick, and defaulted headless games to CPU gradients.
Improved simulation scheduling, recruitment and pathfinding; reduced rendering overhead; restored historical save loading; and refined touch controls, first-launch setup and map generation.
Restored mature resource stock oscillation, improved native GPU reliability and Metal terrain performance, immediate live colony menus, and faster verified asset packaging.
Configurable unit catalogs, additional rendering backends and live renderer switching, presentation performance improvements, and release packaging fixes.
Optimized Fedora release packaging, protected Google Play closed testing and improved native artwork loading.
Corrected native packaging, installed Linux cleanup and iOS distribution verification.
Corrected Android packaging verification and added protected Play channel permission checks before building.
Fixed mobile dependency manifest verification.
Improved native packaging and release verification.
Improved packaging for native desktop and mobile releases.

Refreshed terrain and animated units; a redesigned map editor with touch controls; shared JavaScript map generators and online creation studios for maps, buildings, terrain, resources, music and colony skins; and complete translations.

Normal simulation now runs at 30 ticks per second, with deterministic scheduling and resource growth. Older saves remain supported through versioned migrations. Replays and multiplayer require matching compatible versions.
Packaging update for 0.10.0: Linux, Snap, Flatpak, RPM and Amazon Fire tablet builds.

Online play on the Globulation 2 platform with quick match, rooms and ratings; the Hive Mind commander; custom JavaScript AIs; farm areas as an experiment; match recording; redesigned game rules and end-of-game statistics; interface themes; and complete translations.
Prepare the three-architecture F-Droid Android release.
Prepare updated Windows desktop packaging and refresh the loading wordmark.
